title: Prompting Large Language Models to Reformulate Queries for Moment Localization

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: Prompting Large Language Models to Reformulate Queries for Moment Localization The task of moment localization is to localize a temporal moment in an untrimmed video for a given natural language query.

problems.name: Boundary Ambiguity and Localization Precision
problems.evidence_sentence: Since untrimmed video contains highly redundant contents, the quality of the query is crucial for accurately localizing moments, i.e., the query should provide precise information about the target moment so that the localization model can understand what to look for in the videos.

problems.name: Multi-Moment, Compositional, and Complex Query Grounding

methods.name: LLM Reasoning, Agentic Workflows, or RL Post-Training
methods.evidence_sentence: In contrast to the traditional NLQ benchmark datasets such as ActivityNet Captions [2] and TACoS [3], Ego4D NLQ uses a question sentence (e.g., “Did I turn off the cooker after I fried the meat?”) rather than a narrative sentence, which requires stronger reasoning ability and deeper comprehension of spatio-temporal relationship between objects, places, and people in the videos.

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: For example, the Ego4D dataset uses question sentences as the query to describe relatively complex moments.
